canonical_question: How does the removal of surface asperities using 2000-grid sand paper compare to electropolishing in minimizing surface defects that initiate creep cavitation?

question_variants.question: How does the removal of surface asperities using 2000-grid sand paper compare to electropolishing in minimizing surface defects that initiate creep cavitation?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text confirms that mechanical grinding with 2000-grid sandpaper was used to remove surface asperities. However, there is no mention or comparison of electropolishing as an alternative method, nor any data on how either method specifically minimizes surface defects initiating creep cavitation.
